part1.title: What If Your Money Expired? 💸 Part 1 #shorts
part1.description:
Nobody in Millbrook spends. Bit copies a real 1932 idea from Wörgl, Austria: money that loses value if you keep it.
An original animated "What if...?" story by zylo, part 1 of 8.

full.title: What If Your Money Expired? (Full Story)
full.description:
In 1932, the town of Wörgl in Austria printed money that lost value if you kept it. Bit copies the idea for Millbrook, and gets it very wrong first.
